_comment: Levels in dB relative to the voice (speech RMS). Effects are never boosted to reach loudness: the -14 LUFS target is set on the VOICE, everything else rides at these offsets. sfx_gain_db moves every effect, ambience and music together. Big sounds are also capped so they never peak above the voice. duck_db = extra dB down for everything under the voice while someone speaks. max_effects / min_spacing_s cap the effects; pencil=false turns the per-scene pencil sound off.
